summary: Implemented the Databricks OAuth profile mapping. Added cosmos/profiles/databricks/oauth.py with DatabricksOauthProfileMapping, registered it directly after DatabricksTokenProfileMapping in the ordered list in cosmos/profiles/__init__.py, and added it to the export lists of both the databricks and profiles packages. Added tests/profiles/databricks/test_dbr_oauth.py covering claim checks, token-over-OAuth selection, OAuth selection, profile output, env-var outputs, and that profile args cannot override auth_type or the secret fields. Tests were not run, per instructions. Nothing was committed.
